# Gemify

> Gemify builds simple, powerful Shopify apps for merchants: Bulk Delete Orders, Default Address Lock, and LLMs-full.txt. This file contains the full site content in plain markdown for AI assistants. A shorter index is available at /llms.txt.

## About Gemify

Gemify is a Shopify app development company founded by experienced Shopify developers who understand the challenges merchants face. The mission: intuitive, reliable apps. No bloated features, no confusing interfaces, just clean solutions that help businesses thrive.

Why merchants choose Gemify:

- Shopify Expertise: built by certified Shopify experts who understand daily merchant challenges
- Enterprise Security: store data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256), with regular security audits
- Responsive Support: real human support, replies within 24 hours on business days

## Services

URL: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/services

Beyond its own apps, Gemify builds custom Shopify apps, customizes existing ones, upgrades them to the latest Shopify APIs, and fixes bugs. This covers Gemify apps and Shopify apps built by other developers or agencies.

- Custom App Development: custom apps built for one store, public apps ready for Shopify App Store review, admin/checkout/theme app extensions, integrations with ERPs, CRMs, and other services
- App Customization: new features and settings for Gemify apps, changes to apps built by other developers or agencies, custom rules, reports, and automations, connections to tools the merchant already uses
- Upgrades & Migrations: Shopify API version upgrades, REST to GraphQL Admin API migration, Polaris and App Bridge updates, framework and dependency upgrades
- Bug Fixes & Maintenance: diagnosing and fixing errors and crashes, webhook, sync, and data-consistency issues, performance and reliability improvements, ongoing maintenance and monitoring

How it works:

1. Tell us what you need, using the contact form on the services page or by email (sean.gemify@gmail.com)
2. Free quote: Gemify reviews the request (and the code, for existing apps) and replies with a plan, a timeline, and an estimate
3. Build and review: progress is shared during the project so the merchant can test and give feedback before launch
4. Launch and support: every project includes a post-launch support period for fixing bugs in the delivered work

## Bulk Delete Orders

URL: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/bulk-delete-orders
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/bulk-delete-orders

Clean up a Shopify store by bulk deleting test orders, draft orders, and customers with powerful filters and automatic cancellation. Shopify provides no native way to bulk delete orders; deleting hundreds of orders one by one is time-consuming and error-prone.

Solves:

- Test orders cluttering analytics after development and testing
- Cleanup of imported orders after platform migration
- Duplicate orders from system glitches or integration issues
- GDPR / privacy compliance deletion of old order records

Features:

- Powerful filters: date range, order status, payment status, fulfillment status, tags, customer, and more
- Auto-cancel and delete: orders are automatically cancelled before deletion; fulfilled orders can be deleted too
- Confirm before deleting: a confirmation step lists every order that will be deleted and warns that deletion is permanent
- Job history: track every deletion job in real time, with status, progress, and failures
- Export reports: export job history as CSV for compliance and audits
- Customer cleanup: anonymize customers (mask personal data) or permanently delete them together with their orders
- Supports regular orders, draft orders, and customers

Important notes:

- Deleted orders cannot be recovered; the app recommends filtering carefully, testing with small batches, and exporting a backup first
- Deleting orders removes them from Shopify analytics and reports
- Deleting an order does not delete the customer account; use the app's customer cleanup to delete or anonymize customers

Pricing:

- Free plan: up to 50 order/draft order deletions, bulk customer deletion, live job tracking, and CSV export
- Complete plan: $36/year, unlimited order/draft order deletions, plus customer anonymization (PII masking)

## Default Address Lock

URL: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/default-address-lock
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/default-address-lock

Prevents Shopify from overwriting customers' default addresses when they ship orders to different locations. Since 2015, Shopify has automatically changed a customer's default address to match the most recent order's shipping address. The app detects order-triggered changes and restores the original default address in real time, while intentional manual updates by the customer or staff are preserved.

Solves:

- Gift stores: customers' default addresses keep changing to gift recipients' addresses
- B2B merchants: buyers shipping to clients end up with incorrect default addresses
- CRM-integrated shops: inaccurate customer data disrupts marketing and fulfillment
- Subscription businesses: one-time gift shipments override recurring delivery addresses

Features:

- Smart detection: distinguishes order-triggered changes from intentional manual updates
- Automatic restoration: reverts automatic overwrites in real time, as orders are placed
- Activity dashboard: every protection event and a full history of restored addresses
- Privacy-first: stores only address IDs, never actual address content; personal data stays in Shopify

Pricing:

- Free: up to 30 orders per month
- Basic: $4.99/month (up to 100 orders per month)
- Growth: $24.99/month (up to 500 orders per month)
- Enterprise: $99/month (unlimited orders)

## LLMs-full.txt

URL: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/llms-txt
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/llms-full-txt

Makes Shopify stores AI-ready by generating agents.md, llms.txt, and llms-full.txt files, so AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini can understand a store's products, collections, and pages. Just as robots.txt guides search engines, llms.txt guides AI assistants, helping them recommend products and answer customer questions accurately.

Solves:

- Shoppers increasingly research products through AI assistants, which otherwise work from whatever they can scrape
- Storefront HTML is noisy; models read markdown far more reliably
- Hand-maintaining the files across hundreds of products does not scale
- The standard expects files at the root domain; external hosting means extra infrastructure

Features:

- One-click generation of agents.md, llms.txt, and llms-full.txt from the dashboard
- Choose exactly which products, collections, pages, blog articles, and policies to include, by content type or item by item
- Template editor: edit headings and item formatting with a live preview before publishing
- Scheduled regeneration: hourly, daily, or weekly in the store's own time zone, with a history of every run
- Served natively: files are published to the theme and served by Shopify at /agents.md, /llms.txt, and /llms-full.txt, no extra hosting
- Clean markdown generated from your store content
- No customer data accessed: the app only reads store content

Pricing:

- Free: up to 50 items per content type, with every feature (preview, manual and scheduled generation, template editor, generation history)
- Complete: $9.99/month for unlimited products, collections, pages, and blog articles

## Coming soon

These apps are not on the Shopify App Store yet. Their pages describe what each app does; install links and prices appear once each listing is live.

- [Japan Multiship](https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/japan-multiship): Buyers assign cart items to up to 20 recipients on the cart page and pay once. Postal code autofill with kana name fields, shipping priced per destination from the store's shipping zones and shown before checkout, one fulfillment order per destination, Yamato B2 Cloud CSV export (also for single-address orders), and tracking number import from the carrier CSV. Built for stores in Japan: the store currency must be JPY. Needs the Online Store sales channel; a checkout block for adding destinations is available on Shopify Plus. An "amount off order" discount also lowers the shipping fee and the app flags such orders. App UI in English and Japanese.
- [Best Store Locator](https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/best-store-locator): A searchable map of stores, stockists, or dealers added as a theme block. Maps and address lookup are built in on every plan, with no map account or API key. CSV import with a full preview, safe re-imports, and duplicate detection; addresses that cannot be placed accurately are held for review. Shoppers search by city or ZIP, use their location, filter by tag, see which stores are open now, and signed-in customers can save a favorite store. Location pages with structured data on the Pro plan and above.
- [Checkout Probe](https://gemify-ecom.github.io/apps/checkout-probe): Gets a Shopify checkout ready for WebMCP. Since 2026-09-28, Shopify checkout offers WebMCP tools (get_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout, navigate_to_storefront) to AI agents in the buyer's browser; when a checkout needs something an agent cannot give, the agent stops. Checkout Probe runs a test checkout the way an AI shopping agent would, through Shopify's Checkout MCP, filling in a test buyer and a shipping address, then cancels it; no order is placed. Steps that only show in the browser, such as some checkout UI extensions, may not appear in the test. The report shows each point where an agent would stop (such as a rule that needs buyer input, no Shop Pay, or no shipping rate for the address) with a fix and a link to the matching settings page, and lists what the test cannot check. Read-only: no settings changes, no theme changes, no app blocks.

## Pricing & Billing (all apps)

- Every app offers a free plan: Bulk Delete Orders (50 operations), Default Address Lock (30 orders/month), LLMs-full.txt (up to 50 items per content type)
- Billing is handled through Shopify and appears on the regular Shopify invoice
- Cancel anytime by uninstalling the app through the Shopify admin
- Refunds: contact support; refunds are issued where appropriate

## Privacy & Security

- Minimum data collection: only what each app needs (order data and resource IDs for Bulk Delete Orders, which stores no customer personal information; customer/address IDs for Default Address Lock; store content for LLMs-full.txt)
- Data is never sold, rented, or traded to third parties
- Encryption in transit and at rest, secure sign-in through Shopify, regular security audits, strict access controls
- After uninstall, data is deleted within 30 days (sooner for some apps)
- GDPR and CPRA compliant; answers the customer data and deletion requests that Shopify sends
- Full policy: https://gemify-ecom.github.io/privacy-policy

## Technical Compatibility

- Works with all Shopify plans: Basic, Shopify, Advanced, and Shopify Plus
- Bulk Delete Orders, Default Address Lock, and LLMs-full.txt operate on the backend and add no scripts to storefront pages, so store loading speed is unaffected
- No technical knowledge required; anyone who can use the Shopify admin can use the apps
- Multiple Gemify apps can be installed together without conflicts

## FAQ

Full FAQ (45 questions): https://gemify-ecom.github.io/faq

Highlights:

- Is it safe to delete orders? Yes, but deletion is permanent. The app auto-cancels orders first; test with small batches and export a backup.
- Will Default Address Lock stop customers updating their own addresses? No. Manual updates through the customer account are always preserved.
- Who can see the files LLMs-full.txt generates? They are publicly accessible on the store's domain and contain only content the merchant chose to include.
- How do I get support? Email sean.gemify@gmail.com; replies within 24 hours on business days.
